activity_summary: In the afternoon Richard brought word that the sickles start at Hewlands at six. You tried the old shoes over doubled hose, and they went on. Joan took them to grease the heel-seam. The play bundle stayed tied, and Anne wanted you home before Quiney and Sturley sit down at half past six.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Tried the shoes on and took them off again until morning.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Told you to take a guard for the thistles, and to be back before half past six.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the word, and offered the guard from the peg.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the shoes to grease the heel-seam.

facets.activity: Tried the old shoes for six in the morning

quotes.speaker: richard_shakespeare
quotes.text: Standing on a rush mat is not ten hours in barley stubble

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tomorrow is a back, not a quill
